summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the Jan-2026 batch: Friends API (request/accept/decline/remove/block/unblock/list/search), avatar 0-4 endpoint, per-tier ranked-bot rooms (3 bots <Master, 1 Master/GM, 0 Goonmaster), kill events include shooter_avatar/rank_tier/rank_name/rank_points/is_bot, ONLINE_USERS WS tracking, lobby PlayerCard + FriendsModal + Quick Match counting UP from 0, mobile lobby fit. Backend: 24/24 tests pass (23 fast + 1 slow Diamond bot-fill). Frontend: all critical UI flows verified (lobby card, friends modal w/ 5 tabs + search returning ADD rows, mobile 390x700 fits without scroll, offline navigation).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1491-1496 ranked_bot_count_for_tier — clean integer table: tier>=7 → 0 (Goonmaster never reached), 5-6 → 1 (Master/GM), <5 → 3. Verified all 8 tier indices via direct import.

server.py:1529-1542 get_or_create_ranked_bot_room — per-user RANKED_BOT_ROOMS dict prevents leaking rooms across users; bots get '-RB' suffix for unique naming. cleanup_ranked_bot_room_if_empty triggered only when all real players disconnect (good — re-entry idempotent).

server.py:1583-1584 matchmaker_loop — `if tier_timeout == float('inf'): continue` correctly short-circuits Goonmaster bot-fill. Verified live: 2500-RP user stays queued indefinitely with bot_fill_seconds=-1 from API.

server.py:1678-1701 ONLINE_USERS reference-counted per user — supports multi-tab/multi-mode connections (e.g. casual + ranked open simultaneously won't double-count). Decrement clamped via max(0, ...) — no negative leak.

server.py:1782-1786 auto-accept on reverse-pending — when A->B exists pending and B sends to A, the existing row is flipped to accepted instead of creating a second row. Avoids duplicate-row violation on the (from_user_id, to_user_id) unique index. Verified.

server.py:1851-1862 block clears any prior friendship rows before inserting the one-way block. Subsequent /friends/request returns 403 from either direction. Unblock removes only the blocker's own row (correct directional semantic).
server.py:1879-1892 /users/search — case-insensitive prefix regex, excludes self, returns [] for q<2 chars, projects compact friend-card fields. Limit clamp [1,20] enforced.

server.py:975-979 + 1064-1067 — kill events from both _apply_shoot and _apply_melee carry shooter_avatar/shooter_rank_tier/shooter_rank_name/shooter_rank_points/shooter_is_bot. Verified live in offline mode (kill event captured with all 5 new fields).
Lobby.jsx — Quick Match toast counter now increments 0,1,2,3,4… (live screenshot at t≈4.4s shows '4'). The previous-iteration countdown reversal is fixed.
Lobby.jsx — Mobile 390x700: scrollH==clientH==700 (NO scroll). The previous-iteration overflow regression is resolved. Confirmed via documentElement.scrollHeight.

FriendsModal.jsx — All 5 tabs render with data-testid friends-tab-{friends|incoming|outgoing|blocked|search}; the 'outgoing' tab label is 'SENT' (cosmetic) but testid is correct. Existing player2 friend appears in FRIENDS list with avatar+rank chip+RP+OFFLINE indicator. Unfriend and Block buttons present per row.
Search ADD flow — typing 'play' fetches /api/users/search and renders 3 ADD rows (player2, etc.) with proper PlayerCard + ADD button shape.
/app/backend/tests/pytest.ini — added asyncio_mode=auto so async WS tests run without explicit decorators (fixed pre-existing test infra gap).

success_rate.backend: 100% (24/24 — all friends/avatar/bot-room/kill-event tests pass; Diamond bot-fill verified after 50s real-time wait)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (PlayerCard + FriendsModal + 5 tabs + search + Quick Match UP-counter + mobile fit + offline nav all confirmed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run full backend suite: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v -c /app/backend/tests/pytest.ini --tb=short`. The Diamond bot-fill test takes ~50s (QUEUE_BOT_FILL_SEC=45s) and Master/GM 120s — those are deselected by default if you want fast runs. Use --deselect test_ranked_botfill_low_tier_3_bots for <20s wall time. Frontend: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://blast-arena-servers.preview.emergentagent.com. Login as player1@shooter.com / player123; player2 is already in player1's friends list as accepted. To test live online status, open a second WS connection as player2 and observe /api/friends from player1 → b_row.online flips True/False.
rca of the issue: N/A — no real bugs. Initial Diamond test failure was a test-author tier-threshold mistake (1200 RP = Master, not Diamond) — fixed to use 1000 RP. Initial async tests not running was missing pytest-asyncio + config — installed + added pytest.ini with asyncio_mode=auto.
